Confirmed merged into main as commit `b0318a45` (#463) with the CONSTITUTION.yaml GP-08/GP-09 update intact. Task complete.

## Final report

**PR:** [#463 — "Close GP-08/GP-09: grep-verifiable claim confidence scoring"](https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/463)
**Tier:** TIER1 (no `drizzle/*.sql` or `src/lib/db/schema.ts` touched)
**CI result:** All required checks green (Mandatory Audit Check, Lint, Type Check, Build, Unit Tests, E2E Tests, Asset Registry Coverage, Metadata Index Coverage, Guardrail Presence, Doc checks, CodeQL/Analyze, Secret Scanning, Sentinel Governance). Only Vercel failed (known-rate-limited, non-required).
**Status:** Merged (squash) to `main` as `b0318a45`, branch deleted.

Key finding along the way: a fresh grep confirmed `dispatch-confidence-scoring.ts` (added 2026-07-18) already provides a real numeric confidence pipeline — but it's a signal-based proxy (hedging/knowledge-gap/risk), never a check of whether a claim's factual assertions are actually *true*. That's the real, narrower gap this PR closes with `src/lib/claim-verification.ts`: a Tier-1, grep-verifiable fact-check of backtick-quoted file-path/function-name claims against the repo's real state, producing a 0-1 `confidenceScore` + `lowConfidenceFlagged` boolean, wired into `orchestra-execution-logger.ts`'s `recordOrchestraExecution()` (the real shared persistence point — confirmed the AI Team dispatch route itself persists via `recordActivity`/`activity_log`, not this logger). 13 new tests cover real-claim/high-confidence, fabricated-claim/low-confidence-flagged, mixed, and no-claims cases.

The branch required three merges from `main` before landing since this repo had multiple concurrent sessions merging in parallel (PRs #462, #464, and a GP-20 gap-closure) — each time only the shared `PROGRESS.md` conflicted; `ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml`/`CONSTITUTION.yaml` auto-merged cleanly.
